images.prompt: Modern infographic layout on dark background. Three interconnected nodes representing AI security blindspots: a broken chain for supply chain poisoning, a syringe injecting into a circuit for prompt injection, and a red path crossing a network for lateral movement. Neon warning colors (yellow, red) on black, minimal icons.
images.altText: Critical blindspots in AI agent security supply chain poisoning prompt injection lateral movement
images.caption: Glow addresses critical blindspots including supply chain poisoning and prompt injection.
